source_entries.version_status: PREPRINT arXiv:2203.13381v2, 2022-04-05; not claimed final CVPR bytes
source_entries.method_sections: Sections 3.1 and 3.4; original-task labeled linear probe and exemplars

source_entries.title: Li, Littman, Walsh and Strehl, Knows what it knows: a framework for self-aware learning
source_entries.version_status: 2011 journal publication; downloaded author-hosted Springer article with 2010 copyright
source_entries.method_sections: Sections 3.1-3.2, 4.1-4.2, 6 and 7.2, Algorithm 3 and practical caveats; no new certification of every cited PAC proof

source_entries.title: Grass and Zilberstein 1997, Value-Driven Information Gathering
source_entries.version_status: published AAAI workshop technical report WS-97-06
source_entries.method_sections: Complete six-page paper; especially Sections 2-3, returned-information assumptions and stopping cost

source_entries.method_sections: Complete paper, especially printed p.198 null-space/QR/tolerance procedure

source_entries.title: Michalski, Mozetic, Hong and Lavrac, July 1986, The AQ15 Inductive Learning System: An Overview and Experiments
source_entries.version_status: technical report ISG 86-20 / UIUCDCS-R-86-1260; image-only scan
source_entries.method_sections: Sections 2-4, printed pp.1-9, especially p.3 seed star/maxstar/preference/full-memory mode; p.4 inconsistency handling

source_entries.title: Zheng et al. 2025, Spurious Forgetting in Continual Learning of Language Models
source_entries.version_status: published ICLR paper, complete 66-page PDF including appendices
source_entries.decision_role: C3 S8 and observer recovery-access comparator; separate F.1 check
source_entries.method_sections: Sections 3.1-3.2, 5.1; appendices C,D.2,E,F.1,H,I.1: half-old-data recovery, checkpoint differences, prior teacher outputs; F.1 lemma and following derivation

source_entries.title: Chaudhry et al., Using Hindsight to Anchor Past Knowledge in Continual Learning
source_entries.version_status: PREPRINT arXiv:2002.08165v1, 2020; not claimed final AAAI 2021 bytes
source_entries.method_sections: Sections 2-3, Eqs.5-9, Appendix D pseudocode; replay and learned synthetic anchors modify learning

source_entries.title: Kaelbling, Littman and Cassandra 1998, Planning and Acting in Partially Observable Stochastic Domains
source_entries.decision_role: C1 probabilistic cross-check; C2 decisive finite policy-tree comparator
source_entries.method_sections: Sections 3.1-3.4 and 4.1, printed pp.105-111; Section 4.4 backup equation. General C2 joint-kernel compilation is PI algebra, not a quoted published controller

source_entries.title: Mitchell 1977, Version Spaces: A Candidate Elimination Approach to Rule Learning
source_entries.decision_role: C1 static principle, C4 all-positive distinction, T active-learning antecedent
source_entries.method_sections: Entire six-page paper, especially Sections 2.2,3.1,3.2.1-3.2.2; boundaries, failures, query and merge interface

source_entries.title: Lovell 1963, Seasonal Adjustment of Economic Time Series and Multiple Regression
source_entries.version_status: PREPRINT / Cowles Discussion Paper 151; image-only working-paper scan, not final JASA typesetting
source_entries.method_sections: Section 5, Theorem 5.1, printed pp.26-30; proof pp.43-45. Strict rank k+d<t on printed p.28. Computational discussion pp.24-25

source_entries.title: Lenc and Vedaldi 2015, Understanding Image Representations by Measuring Their Equivariance and Equivalence
source_entries.decision_role: C3 S1 decisive regularized equivalence family
source_entries.method_sections: Section 2 and 2.1, equivalence objective; Section 2.3 stitching and 3.3 evaluation. Identity-centered fit is PI specialization, not a claimed evaluated sparse variant

source_entries.title: Li, Littman and Walsh 2008, Knows What It Knows: A Framework For Self-Aware Learning
source_entries.decision_role: T earlier KWIK protocol and acquisition interface
source_entries.method_sections: Sections 2-5; protocol, enumeration, navigation, learner combinations and limitations

source_entries.title: Pawlak and Skowron 2007, Rough sets and Boolean reasoning
source_entries.version_status: published author survey and method exposition; not earliest-priority proof
source_entries.method_sections: Complete Sections 2.1 and 2.4: empty-entry convention, consistent-table restriction and object-relative minimal rules

source_entries.title: Gomez-Villa et al. 2024, Exemplar-free Continual Representation Learning via Learnable Drift Compensation
source_entries.method_sections: Sections 3.1-3.4 and Section 4 fit details; previous/current encoders and prototypes

source_entries.title: Rabin and Scott 1959, Finite Automata and Their Decision Problems
source_entries.version_status: published IBM journal article, author-archive copy
source_entries.method_sections: Chapter II Section 5, Definitions 9-11 and Theorem 11 with proof

source_entries.method_sections: Sections 3.2-3.5, Eqs.6-8 and Algorithms1-2; retained projections, modified encoder training and optional distillation

source_entries.version_status: published NeurIPS paper with appendices; not discovery preprint v2

source_entries.title: Farajtabar, Azizan, Mott and Li 2020, Orthogonal Gradient Descent for Continual Learning
source_entries.method_sections: Complete Section 3 and Algorithm1, stored boundary gradients and local nonlinear approximation

reading_limits: Text extraction and OCR are fallible, especially mathematical notation. Originals remain controlling; scanned decisive pages are separately rendered.
The source-role inventory is not a claim that this preparation pass reread every appendix or independently validated every proof.
No exact wrapper priority or unspecified joint-system identity is created by full-text availability.
Source URLs are historical provenance from the frozen audit; local byte/page access rechecked 2026-09-07, no claim of fresh remote retrieval.
